hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. For focused questions, run `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md) instead of grepping raw files. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture context."}}'   || true ;; esac

mkdir -p graphify-out 2>/dev/null; touch graphify-out/.needs_update 2>/dev/null; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Files modified. Graph stale (graphify-out/.needs_update flag set). Run `graphify --update .` after batch of edits complete."}}'

PROMPT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('prompt',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$PROMPT" in */frontend-design*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"After implementing the design, run `graphify --update .` to refresh the graph."}}' ;; esac
if [ -f graphify-out/.needs_update ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"Edits this session - graph stale. Run `graphify --update .` to refresh."}'; fi
